instruction: Go to Apple's Human Interface Guidelines for typography, gather the primary guidance on typography best practices, and save this core information as 'typography_notes.docx' on the desktop, leaving out extra resource links.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple HIG typography page and saving content to docx. Evaluator checks for key terms related to typography guidelines (typography, font, text, design, style), minimum word count of 100, and at least 5 paragraphs. Custom getter extracts document content and structure, custom metric validates keyword presence and document completeness. State-based evaluation without external ground truth.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 30% word count (>=100 words), 20% paragraph count (>=5 paragraphs), 50% keyword presence (5 key terms)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts document content (paragraphs, word count, paragraph count) using python-docx
Metric properly handles expected parameter when type=rule (directly accesses rules dict)
Postconfig ensures document is saved before evaluation (activates window and sends Ctrl+S)
Score weights (30% word count, 20% paragraph count, 50% keywords) match metadata scoring_breakdown
Required keywords (typography, font, text, design, style) are semantically relevant to the task
Minimum thresholds (100 words, 5 paragraphs) are reasonable for verifying substantive content extraction
LIMITATION: Keyword check is basic and cannot verify content is actually from Apple HIG (no ground truth)
LIMITATION: Cannot verify user navigated to correct URL or that content represents best practices
LIMITATION: Cannot verify "omit supplementary resources" requirement was followed
LIMITATION: Generic typography text meeting keyword/length criteria could pass even if not correct content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding more specific keywords unique to Apple HIG (e.g., "SF Pro", "San Francisco", "accessibility", "Dynamic Type")
Consider checking for specific typography metrics/values mentioned in Apple guidelines
Consider validating file location is actually on Desktop (not just hardcoded path)
Consider higher minimum word count (200+) to ensure substantive content extraction
Note: Task is inherently difficult to verify without ground truth content from the actual webpage
